items.title: [2026-07-07] Sell your vehicle owner-direct — keep every rupee (Image Prompt)
items.content:
Editorial automotive-marketplace promo poster, vertical 4:5, QckServe brand.

SCENE: a clean urban Indian setting after monsoon rain — a used motorcycle and a hatchback parked side by side, warm evening light, a young owner handing keys directly to a buyer, no dealer in frame.
SUBJECT: the owner-to-buyer handshake over the vehicle as the emotional focus; confident, friendly, real.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: a floating smartphone shows the QckServe app listing screen — a vehicle card with photo, price, 'Call owner directly' button, and a bold '₹0 to list' badge.
COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking, NO gradients — deep charcoal #1A1A1A base, primary orange #ef6723, accent #FF6B00, off-white #FCF9F8 for cards; one accent used sparingly.
LIGHTING: soft post-rain diffused daylight, gentle reflections on wet asphalt, clean shadows.
TYPE HIERARCHY: one oversized condensed headline 'SELL IT YOURSELF', an italic-serif kicker 'owner to owner, no middleman', small 'qckserve.in' wordmark bottom-left.
EYE FLOW: struck dealer's cut → giant ₹0 → handshake → phone UI → wordmark.
CAMERA: 35mm, eye-level, shallow depth of field, editorial magazine framing.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, mobile-first legibility, one memorable device (the price-strike: dealer's cut struck out beside a giant ₹0).
Reserve the TOP-LEFT logo zone empty (~140px square) — logo placed manually.
